column1: # Challenge Keyword Finder - stat counters -> actor keywords (hand-kept, edit freely).
# Some challenges have no conditions at all: the game counts them with a stat counter
# (the CHAL SNAM, e.g. "Deathclaws Killed"). Fallout76.exe holds the stat list
# (sStat<X>Killed) next to a matching keyword list (ActorType<X>_DO), checked
# 17 Nov 2026 against live (Oct 23) and PTS (Nov 14) exes - the "note" says which
# pair proves each row. Only used when the challenge has no target condition of
# its own. Keywords comma-separated, exact KYWD EDIDs.

column3: PROVEN two ways (17 Nov 2026): (1) the game's own live lifetime challenge 'Kill a Canine' (Challenge_Lifetime_Kill_Animals_SUB_Canine, CHAL 0043AD21) tests HasKeyword ActorTypeFeralDog [KYWD:0002CB97]; (2) the engine's dog default object KeywordActorTypeDog_DO (DFOB 0007CB51; exe text 'This identifies an actor that is a dog.') points at ActorTypeFeralDog, not ActorTypeDog.
